text: This table compares the performance of three models (X-Net, CLCI, and RAX) across different planes (Axial, Sagittal, Coronal) using metrics such as Dice, Precision, Recall, and F1 scores.
summary: The X-Net model consistently outperforms the other two models in terms of all evaluated metrics except for Precision in the Axial plane. The RAX model shows higher Recall values compared to CLCI across all planes but lower Precision values.

key_observations: X-Net has the highest Dice score (0.7104) and F1 score (0.8045) in the Axial plane.
RAX has the highest Recall value of 0.7801 in the Axial plane.
CLCI has the lowest Precision value of 0.6928 in the Coronal plane.
